$description: Typographic scale for the 'adminlte-classic' template (Classic Admin). Obtained by observing the public visual identity of AdminLTE — a humanist sans-serif family and a moderate size scale, without large jumps between levels. Original document — see ATTRIBUTION.md.

base.$value: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
base.$description: Primary typeface, used for body text, headings, and UI components. A humanist sans-serif with good legibility at high data density (tables, dashboards).

monospace.$description: Monospaced family for tabular/numeric values, codes, and IDs when vertical digit alignment is needed.

sm.$description: 14px — supporting text, table cells, form labels.

medium.$description: Used in card titles and table headers — emphasis without being as heavy as bold.

semibold.$description: Used in highlighted numbers (KPIs) and page titles.

dense.$description: Table cells and dense data lists.
